reed_blade.name: Reed Blade
reed_blade.description: A long, flexible blade of reed-steel. Light in the hand, quick to answer.

quarry_maul.name: Quarry Maul
quarry_maul.description: A stoneworker's maul, re-hafted for something with a longer reach and worse intentions.

chime_staff.name: Chime Staff
chime_staff.description: A surveyor's staff with a bell at the tip. It strikes at a distance, softly, and the sound arrives twice.

lantern_offhand.name: Reed Lantern
lantern_offhand.description: A copper lantern with a reed wick. It makes the dark less certain.

reed_buckler.name: Reed Buckler
reed_buckler.description: Woven reed over a copper hoop. It will not stop a maul, but it will stop a mistake.

echo_chime.name: Echo Chime
echo_chime.description: A hand chime that answers a question you did not ask. Found in the Sunken Choir.

traveller_cloak.name: Traveller's Cloak
traveller_cloak.description: Wool, wax, and a patch at the shoulder. It has been rained on in three valleys.

reedweave_cloak.name: Reedweave Cloak
reedweave_cloak.description: Reedfolk work: layered reed fibre that sheds water and keeps the wearer moving.

quarry_coat.name: Quarry Coat
quarry_coat.description: Heavy leather and stone dust. It turns a blade and slows a walk.

listener_coat.name: Listener's Coat
listener_coat.description: Slate cloth with a copper thread at the cuff. It belonged to someone who wrote things down.

river_stone.name: River Stone
river_stone.description: A smooth black stone from the north channel. It is warm when the water is cold.

copper_bell.name: Copper Bell
copper_bell.description: A thumb bell with a cracked lip. The crack makes it honest.

hush_lantern.name: Hush Lantern
hush_lantern.description: A lantern that burns without a flame. In the Hush it shows the shape of what is missing.

ferry_knot.name: Ferry Knot
ferry_knot.description: Three knots tied by Nissa. A map, a promise, and a joke, in that order.

stag_charm.name: Stag's Antler
stag_charm.description: A splinter of pale chime-stone from the Hollow Stag. It hums when you stand still.

reed_tonic.name: Reed Tonic
reed_tonic.description: Bitter, green, and reliable. Restores health.

clear_water.name: Clear Water
clear_water.description: Cold water from the north channel. Restores breath.

hum_reed.name: Hum-Reed
hum_reed.description: A hollow reed that keeps a note after it is cut.

resin.name: Pine Resin
resin.description: Sticky, amber, useful. Smells like the foundry.

copper_scrap.name: Copper Scrap
copper_scrap.description: Bent sheet and wire. The valley is held together with this.

humstone_shard.name: Humstone Shard
humstone_shard.description: A dark chip of the singing stone. It remembers being struck.

glassgrass_fibre.name: Glassgrass Fibre
glassgrass_fibre.description: Fine, sharp, and stronger than it looks. Rings when bent.

river_clay.name: River Clay
river_clay.description: Grey clay from the channel bank. It holds a shape and a sound.

echo_glass.name: Echo Glass
echo_glass.description: A shard of Glasswood. It shows a light that is not in the room.

resonance_fork.name: Resonance Fork
resonance_fork.description: A field tuning fork made to Mira's pattern. It can find the chord in a stubborn stone.

climber_hook.name: Climber's Hook
climber_hook.description: A short hook and a loop of rope. Marked ledges become paths.

lantern_post_kit.name: Lantern Post Kit
lantern_post_kit.description: A post, a hook, a wick. Light a place and it remembers you.

camp_kit.name: Camp Kit
camp_kit.description: Oilcloth, a pot, and a bedroll. A place to stop.

resonator_kit.name: Resonator Kit
resonator_kit.description: A tuned stone on a copper frame. It holds one note until you change it.

reed_bridge_kit.name: Reed Bridge Kit
reed_bridge_kit.description: Bundled reed and rope. Enough to cross a gap that was not there yesterday.

songbed_kit.name: Songbed Kit
songbed_kit.description: Roots, reed seed, and a copper wire. It teaches a patch of ground to sing again.
